testSuite: Phase A: Application Shell Test Suite

tests.name: Unauthenticated access redirect to /#/login
tests.expected: Redirects to /#/login automatically
tests.actual: Redirected to /#/login

tests.name: Empty Employee ID validation
tests.expected: Displays 'กรุณากรอกรหัสพนักงาน' and halts submission
tests.actual: Error alert shown: 'กรุณากรอกรหัสพนักงาน'

tests.name: Empty Password validation
tests.expected: Displays 'กรุณากรอกรหัสผ่าน' and halts submission
tests.actual: Error alert shown: 'กรุณากรอกรหัสผ่าน'

tests.name: Development Login success
tests.expected: Redirects to /#/home and establishes sessionStorage session
tests.actual: Redirected to /#/home, session established with authMode=DEVELOPMENT

tests.name: Tab refresh preserves session
tests.expected: Session maintained within same browser tab
tests.actual: Session maintained across page refreshes in tab

tests.name: Logout clears session
tests.expected: Clears sessionStorage and redirects to /#/login
tests.actual: Session removed, redirected to /#/login

tests.name: Route Guard protects /#/stock after logout
tests.expected: Direct navigation to /#/stock redirects to /#/login
tests.actual: Route Guard blocked access and redirected to /#/login

tests.name: Corrupt session schema handling
tests.expected: Safely discards invalid session and redirects to /#/login
tests.actual: Invalid session caught by try/catch, purged, redirected to /#/login

tests.name: Zero Credentials in Source Code
tests.expected: No real passwords, tokens, or enterprise secrets in repository
tests.actual: 0 credentials found across all files (.js, .json, .md, .py, .env)

tests.name: Password not logged in console or sessionStorage
tests.expected: Password cleared from memory, never saved to storage or logs
tests.actual: sessionStorage contains zero password fields, zero console logging

tests.name: Sales KPI Placeholder (NOT_CONNECTED)
tests.expected: Displays 'NOT_CONNECTED' and 'รอเชื่อมต่อข้อมูล', no fake numbers, no 0
tests.actual: All 5 sales cards display 'NOT_CONNECTED' with status badge

tests.name: Quick Action Stock navigation
tests.expected: Clicking button navigates to /#/stock
tests.actual: Navigates to /#/stock cleanly

tests.name: Stock database availability
tests.expected: STOCK_DATABASE contains 218 verified records
tests.actual: 218 items loaded and displayed in table

tests.name: A07 stock counts per P/N
tests.expected: SM-A075FLVDTHL shows ช1: 2, ช2: 5, รวม: 7; SM-A076BLVCTHL shows ช1: 6, ช2: 5, รวม: 11
tests.actual: Exact counts displayed in Table View and Card View

tests.name: Zero stock display
tests.expected: Displays numeric '0' via 0, not empty or '-'
tests.actual: Zero items render '0' properly

tests.name: Hash router prevents static Vercel 404
tests.expected: Direct URL loading with hash routes works without 404
tests.actual: Hash routing completely client-side compatible with Vercel static hosting

tests.name: Active navigation menu indicator
tests.expected: Matches current route and updates breadcrumb
tests.actual: Active class applied and breadcrumb shows current page title

tests.name: Mobile viewport 360px-375px
tests.expected: Login card and mobile bottom navigation render cleanly
tests.actual: Responsive layout adapts cleanly without horizontal overflow

tests.name: Tablet viewport 768px
tests.expected: Navigation does not obstruct content, cards stack cleanly
tests.actual: Clean single/two column flow without collision

tests.name: Desktop viewport 1366px-1920px
tests.expected: Fixed sidebar, sticky header, full multi-column grid
tests.actual: Full desktop experience rendered with glassmorphism design

tests.name: JavaScript console errors
tests.expected: 0 uncaught errors during normal operation
tests.actual: 0 uncaught runtime exceptions

tests.name: Asset HTTP status
tests.expected: All assets (shell.css, login.css, auth.js, router.js, stock_data.js, app.js) return 200
tests.actual: All assets return HTTP 200 / 304
